Agent13SafeWeights.family_sum_le_incomin:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    ∀ (y N : ℕ) (f : Fin N → ℕ),
      Function.Injective f →
        (∀ (i : Fin N), Agent13SafeFamily.Safe (f i) ∧ Lychrel196.step (f i) = y) →
          ∑ i, w (f i) ≤ Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w y
Agent13SafeWeights.finite_family_weight_:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ∀ (y N : ℕ),
        Agent13SafeFamily.Safe y →
          ∀ (f : Fin N → ℕ),
            Function.Injective f →
              (∀ (i : Fin N), Agent13SafeFamily.Safe (f i) ∧ Lychrel196.step (f i) = y) →
                ↑N * w y ≤ Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w y
Agent13SafeWeights.full_safe_fiber_finit: ∀ (y : ℕ), {n | Agent13SafeFamily.Safe n ∧ Lychrel196.step n = y}.Finite
Agent13SafeWeights.incoming_nonneg: ∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ), Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w → ∀ (y : ℕ), 0 ≤ Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w y
Agent13SafeWeights.incoming_weight_lower:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        2 ≤ m →
          ↑(9 * 10 ^ (m - 2)) * w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1) ≤
            Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1)
Agent13SafeWeights.incoming_weight_ratio:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        2 ≤ m →
          ↑(9 * 10 ^ (m - 2)) ≤
            Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1) /
              w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1)
Agent13SafeWeights.incoming_weight_sqrt_:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ∀ (m : ℕ),
        2 ≤ m →
          9 / 100 * √(10 / 11) * √↑(10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1) <
            Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1) /
              w (10 ^ (2 * m) + 99 * 10 ^ (m - 1) - 1)
Agent13SafeWeights.mem_safeFiber_iff: ∀ (n y : ℕ), n ∈ Agent13SafeWeights.safeFiber y ↔ Agent13SafeFamily.Safe n ∧ Lychrel196.step n = y
Agent13SafeWeights.no_uniform_multiplier:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ∀ (C : ℝ), ∃ y, Agent13SafeFamily.Safe y ∧ C * w y < Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w y
Agent13SafeWeights.not_exists_uniform_bo:
∀ (w : ℕ → ℝ),
  Agent13SafeWeights.PositiveOnSafe w →
    Agent13SafeWeights.AntitoneOnSafe w →
      ¬∃ C, ∀ (y : ℕ), Agent13SafeFamily.Safe y → Agent13SafeWeights.incoming w y ≤ C * w y
Agent13SafeWeights.predecessor_le: ∀ (n y : ℕ), Lychrel196.step n = y → n ≤ y
